title: NEXARA Tool Evidence Binding — Design Contract V1
description: Closes the evidence binding chain: ToolInvocation → ExecutionContext → EvidenceArtifact → EvidenceStore → CrossRefValidator → Receipt. Remediation for P1 evidence_runtime_chain_open.

step_2.name: ExecutionContext
step_2.produces: Immutable context snapshot at invocation time

step_3.name: EvidenceArtifact
step_3.alignment: Existing tools.py uses kind=execution_receipt. Phase 2 adds kind=tool_invocation to EvidenceArtifact.kind enum.

step_4.name: EvidenceStore
step_4.produces: Append-only evidence record with integrity envelope
step_4.api: EvidenceStore.add(mission_id, kind, title, content, trace_id, ...) → evidence_id

step_5.name: CrossRefValidator
step_5.runtime_plan: CrossRefValidator is currently design-time in contracts/mission_lifecycle/. Phase 2 implementation moves core validation logic to src/nexara_prime/cross_ref.py as runtime component. Design-time tests remain for contract verification.

step_6.name: Receipt
step_6.produces: Receipt attesting to evidence chain integrity
step_6.stored_in: EvidenceStore (receipt IS an EvidenceArtifact with kind=receipt)

runtime_migration_plan.phase_2_target: tools.py emits evidence with kind=tool_invocation + evidence_chain array linking all 6 steps
runtime_migration_plan.cross_ref_runtime: Core validation logic from contracts/mission_lifecycle/cross_ref_validator.py moves to src/nexara_prime/cross_ref.py
runtime_migration_plan.compatibility: Existing kind=execution_receipt evidence preserved. New kind=tool_invocation added without breaking existing.
